biggest_catch: The $200 pays out as a slow $50/month drip over four months and each month requires a $3,000 average daily balance - a poor return on parked cash.
catches: Business customers only - requires a business entity.
Promo code START200 required on the application.
Payout is a slow drip: $50 per calendar month, so the full $200 takes 4 qualifying months.
You must maintain an AVERAGE DAILY BALANCE of $3,000 each month to earn that month's $50 - one low day drags the average down.
No monthly fees and no minimum opening deposit keep the cost at zero, but the reward is small relative to the $3,000 parked.
Normal tax treatment applies to bank bonuses (reported as income).
The $50/month figure is a monthly cap, not a guaranteed payout - actual cashback depends on account activity; official terms only promise "up to $200" total.
